why: An August 2026 arXiv preprint by Dynnikov, 'On Zeeman's collapsibility conjecture for non-standard polyhedra,' claims that if the conjecture holds for standard polyhedra it holds in general (a reduction result); unclear from the abstract alone whether this counts as settling a case of the stated problem or is a related reformulation, and it has not been read.
